Format an Editable Table 1

table1_flextable.Rd

Creates a flextable with bold variable headings, indented detail rows (category levels, summary statistics, and missing rows), centered group columns, repeating column headers, and an optional explanatory footer. Keeps variable headings with their first detail row in Word. The returned object can be customized further with any flextable function before being placed in a document.

Usage

table1_flextable(x, font_size = 10, font_family = "Arial", include_notes = TRUE)

Arguments

x

A nice_table1 object returned by nice_SMD_table1, or a nice_trial_table1 object returned by nice_trial_table1.

font_size

A single positive number: the font size in points for the header and body. Footnotes use max(8, font_size - 1). Default 10. Reduce it (for example 8 or 9) for wide tables with many groups.

font_family

A single character string naming the font, for example "Arial" or "Times New Roman". The font must be available on the machine that opens the document. Default "Arial".

include_notes

TRUE (default) or FALSE. Whether to add the footnotes stored in x$notes as a table footer. The footnote content itself is chosen with the notes argument of nice_SMD_table1 ("full", "short", "none"); if x$notes is empty no footer is added regardless of this argument.

Value

A flextable object, suitable for customization or inclusion in Word, HTML, and Quarto/R Markdown documents.

See also

save_table1_docx, nice_SMD_table1, table1_kable

Examples

d <- example_table1_data()
tab <- nice_SMD_table1(d, "group", c("age", "sex", "smoking"),
  group_for_SMD = c("Control", "Treatment"))

## Default table
ft <- table1_flextable(tab)
class(ft)
#> [1] "flextable"

## Smaller font and a different typeface for a wide table
ft_small <- table1_flextable(tab, font_size = 8, font_family = "Times New Roman")

## No footer, for example when notes are written in the manuscript text
ft_plain <- table1_flextable(tab, include_notes = FALSE)

## Compact legend: choose it when the table is built
tab_short <- nice_SMD_table1(d, "group", c("age", "sex", "smoking"),
  group_for_SMD = c("Control", "Treatment"),
  show_missing = "if_any", notes = "short")
ft_short <- table1_flextable(tab_short)

## Further customization with flextable before inserting into a document
ft_custom <- table1_flextable(tab_short, font_size = 9)
ft_custom <- flextable::color(ft_custom, part = "header", color = "#243746")
ft_custom <- flextable::bg(ft_custom, part = "header", bg = "#E8EEF3")

## Insert into an existing Word document
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".docx")
doc <- officer::read_docx()
doc <- flextable::body_add_flextable(doc, value = ft_custom)
print(doc, target = path)
unlink(path)

## In a Quarto chunk, put the flextable last to render it:
##   table1_flextable(tab, font_size = 9)
